chapter.verse: Sanggamte aw, thukhenna a ngatzaw thuak ding ka hihlam uh hong thei na hih mah bangun note zong hilhcian sya tampi suahhuai lo hi.
A hang pen i vekpi-in thu tampi ah i khial thei hi. Kampauna ah a khial lo khatpeuh a om leh amah micingtaak hi a, a pumpi bup zong a kikem zo ahi hi.
Sakolte i thu hong man nadingin kamkaih thuahsak lehang amau' pumpi bup i hawl thei pah hi.
Tembawte zong en dih un. Amaute gol mahmahin huih khauhte tawh a kikhiin ahih hangin a heina pek a neu mahmah khat in a hawlpa' deihdeihna lamah a hawl hi ziau hi.
Tua dan mahin leii zong pumpi na a neuno khat ahih hangin na a lianpite kisialhpih thei hi. Meikuang neuno khat hangin zong gamlak a zaipi khat kangtum thei cih phawk ni.
Tua hi a, leii cih pen meikuang ahi hi. I pumpi nate laka om diklohna thu teng kiphualna hi a, pumpi bup nin baangsak hi. Leii in nuntakna leengpei haltum a, amah ahihleh hell ah kihaltum hi.
A hang pen mihing in gamsate leh vasate, bokvak awmtal ganhingte leh tuipi ganhingte a namkimin zualsak thei a, zong zualsak khinzo hi.
Ahi zongin leii a zualsak thei mihing kuamah om lo hi. Leii pen a omkhong theilo khansiatna hi a, sihtheihna gu tawh kidim hi.
Leii tawh Topa leh Pa i phat a, tua leii mah tawh Pasian' melbaang dinga kibawl mihingte i samsia hi.
Kam khat bek panin thupha paihna leh haamsiatna pusuak hi. Ka sanggamte aw, hih thute tua bang ding hilo hi.
Tuinak khat bek pan ciktui a lim leh a alh phulkhawm ahi hiam?
Ka sanggamte aw, theikung panin olive gah, lenggui panin theigah piang ahi hiam? Tui-alh bual panin zong tuilim piang theilo hi.
Note' lakah kua pilin thuthei ahi hiam? Amah in pilna pana piang lungnemna tawh a sep a bawl teng, gamtat luhek a hoih tawh hong lakkhia ta hen.
Ahi zongin na lungsim sung uhah kidemnopna leh angsung theihna a nei na hih uhleh kisialkha kei un. Thumaan a lehngat zuauphuak na hiding uh hi.
Tua pilna pen tunglam pan hong pai hilo-in a leitungvai, lungsim bulphuhvai leh a dawivai hi lel hi.
A hang pen kidemnopna leh angsung theihna a omna mun ah thulela kitukalh ding a, tatsiatna namkim piang ding hi.
Tunglam pana pilna ahihleh khatna ah a siangtho, tua ciangin a thunuam, a thudik, thu a sangthei, thukhualna leh gahleteh hoih tawh a kidim hi a, deidan nei lo-in kineihkhem lo hi.
Tua hi a, kilemna a bawlte pen diktatna a gahkhiasak nopna lemna khaici a vawhte ahi uh hi.
